newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Wing Tiek buys 20 pct in Philippines' NSC.
newsitem.headline: Wing Tiek buys 20 pct in Philippines' NSC.

text.p: Malaysia's Wing Tiek Holdings Bhd said it has acquired a further 20 percent stake in Philippines' National Steel Corp (NSC) to widen its equity in the state steelmaker to 75 percent.
The 448.68 million additional NSC shares were bought on Sept 26 through Philippines National Development Corp (NDC) for $150 million, Wing Tiek said in a statement.
The transaction was the second and final tranche of secondary NSC shares which the Wing Tiek consortium was to acquire from the NDC, Wing Tiek said.

Wing Tiek group managing director Joseph Chong said last month a fresh capital infusion of US$135 million in NSC by end-October would contribute to the completion of expansion plans and enhance the company's financial capabilities by next year.
